checks: Desktop menu, leaderboard empty state, controls guide, settings and no horizontal overflow.
Two authenticated clients create/join a private match, wait for host/countdown and receive the fixed loadout.
Real pointer lock, WASD, automatic AR, immediate shotgun tap, keyboard slots/reload/jump and full-health heal guard.
Landscape touch joystick, sprint toggle, slot selection and short fire/reload/jump taps reach authoritative state.
Real touch camera/aim and AR shots damage another human; keyboard healing completes its timed action.
Real mouse aiming hits the rival; touch healing consumes one charge and restores exactly 50 health up to the cap.
Explicit leave ends the incomplete private round without a rating award; crew creation renders real standings.
Portrait menu and live HUD fit; Relaxed practice reaches the server and all three rivals move and fire.
Explicit re-entry creates a new Challenging practice room; rotation keeps gameplay mounted.
Received AR/shotgun events contain one/nine traces with the exact center endpoint; real shots produce shield-only damage and a 2-shield/22-health break.
realInputUi.limitation: Actual keyboard/mouse/touch input and authoritative server state on desktop browser sessions; touch was emulated, not a physical phone.
